#### 1. mitochondrial dna depletion syndrome 14A (encephalomyopathic type)  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.791)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-169911, Reactome:R-HSA-9837999)

Mutations in OPA1 disrupt mitochondrial inner membrane fusion, leading to both optic atrophy (Behr syndrome) and encephalomyopathy (mitochondrial DNA depletion syndrome 14A).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in OPA1 that lead to a gain-of-function mechanism in either disease would falsify this hypothesis. Also, the absence of shared neurological or visual phenotypes in patients with OPA1 mutations would be falsifying. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of OPA1 in mitochondrial dynamics and its impact on neuronal and muscle function could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting mitochondrial health for both Behr syndrome and mitochondrial DNA depletion syndromes.
